row: Canine Massage is used as a remedial therapy for dogs, to help with issues such as: muscular and myofascial pain, mobility issues,  orthopedic issues, muscular injury and scar tissue re-modelling Massage is THE most effective therapy to rehabilitate and recondition your dog’s muscles for movement, mobility and longevity! Please note; veterinary consent is required to massage dogs in the UK. please visit our website for more info www.k9-massage.co.uk
